params.body:
## What

Three changes on Beheer > Inzichten > Garages.

**1. An info mark at "Handelingen per week".** A small "i" in a circle after the head text: a button with the accessible name "Hoe wordt dit geteld?", 20px with a 44px tap target. Pointing at it, reaching it with the keyboard or tapping it opens three short lines: what counts as an act of the garage itself (as `GarageHealth::sources()` counts it, a sale to a colleague counting for the buyer), what does not (enquiries, sign-ins and edits, the work of platform administrators where the row says who acted) and that the two numbers beside it are the last 28 whole days and the 28 before, today excluded. Escape or a press elsewhere closes it.

The app-wide tooltip (`data-tip`) is one dark line of 240px that disappears on scroll, so three lines do not read in it. The mark is therefore a new shared piece, `x-ui.info` (`resources/js/ui-info.js`, styled in `ui.css`): a popover on the design-system surface with `--ui-shadow-2`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` on the button, kept inside its card and inside the window. The text is in the page, never in a `title`. It is listed in the component README, `docs/design-system.md` and `/huisstijl`.

A phone hides the column heads, so there the same mark stands over the list.

"Status" carries the same mark, but it does not repeat the rule: it says in one line that the status follows from the two numbers, and links to the fold "Hoe dit geteld wordt" under the list, which it opens.

**2. A filter on modules.** One segmented choice in the filter line: Alle, Stock, Biedingen, Beide. A garage with both modules is also a garage with Stock and one with Biedingen; a closed account (both modules off) is in none of the three and keeps its own status in the unfiltered tab. The filter works on the server (`GarageHealth::within()`), combines with the status and the search, and stands in the address as `modules=stock|bidding|both`, so the status links, the sort links, the search form and the way back from an opened garage keep it. An unknown value shows every garage.

With the filter on, everything the tab shows describes the selection: the list, the counts per status, the verdict (which then opens with "Met Stock:"), the note under the list and the chart per month.

**3. The running month no longer says who stopped.** The chart "Groeit het aantal actieve garages?" computed "stopped" for the running month as "active last month and not this month". Two days into a month that is nearly everybody, drawn as a large red bar. A month that is not over cannot know this. `GarageHealth::months()` now gives the running month no `stopped` value; it counts `not_yet` instead: who of last month has not acted yet. The screen draws no bar under the line for the running month, and the bubble and the table show one neutral line "Nog niet actief deze maand". The note says the hatched month is still running and that who is no longer active is only known when it ends; the definitions moved into the fold. The headline of the block already described the last complete month.

The word changes too. "Gestopt" reads as having left, while a garage that skips one month is counted there and under "terug" the month after. It is now "Niet meer actief" (fr "Devenus inactifs", en "No longer active", de "Nicht mehr aktiv"), in the legend, the bubble, the table and the note. It is not an error, so the bar under the line is a calm mid grey instead of the data red.

Other running periods on this tab were checked: the status of a garage, the small chart of a row and the weeks of an opened garage all end yesterday and compare whole days only.

## Rules

R P2-10.42, R P2-10.43 and R P2-10.45 updated; R P2-10.47 added for the module filter.

## Tests

`GarageHealthTest`: the running month carries no stopped value and a not-yet-active count, complete months keep the equation; the module filter narrows the list, the counts and the base per month, combines with status and search, stays in the status links, the sort links and the search form, and falls back to all on an unknown value; the head carries the info mark with its accessible name and the explanation, without `title`. `ui-info.test.js` covers placing and opening.

Checked in the browser on demo data at 1440 and 390.
params.title: Garages: an info mark at the acts, a module filter, and a running month that does not say who stopped
